items.a: Yes — we cater everything from office lunches to private parties, from our full comfort-food and boba menu. Tell us your headcount and date in the form and we will put together a quote.

items.q: Can I book the space for a private event?
items.a: We host private and corporate gatherings in the evenings. The room seats around 24 and fits about 40 standing. Share your details and we will confirm availability.

items.q: How far in advance should I reach out?
items.a: The more notice the better, but we will always try to make it work. A week or two ahead is a safe bet for larger events and catering orders.
The space, tables and seating arranged for your group, and a host on-site. Food and drinks are quoted from our menu based on your headcount.
Plenty — vegetarian dishes, paneer and tofu options, and a full non-coffee lineup of boba, shakes, and teas. Note anything specific in the form.
